_doc: CLOCKWORK-1 (owner, 2026-11-12): a stopped or inaccurate clock is not a working clock. Every stage of every loop declares its cadence, where it leaves evidence (a JSONL log with an `at` field) and how late it may be. foundation/clockwork.py reads the evidence, computes freshness, missed ticks and drift per stage, issues a catch-up for a stage that missed, settles a catch-up by the name of the stage it closes, and escalates a stage that stays missed. Consumers: foundation/clockwork.py, tests/foundation/test_clockwork.py, the lane's daily sweep.

escalation.what: run the stage's own command once now, off schedule
file docs/issues/Q-CLOCK-<stage>.json with the stage as its owner and the stage's probe as the closing probe
dispatch the stage's second path (a GitHub Actions run on the built-in token) and mark the first path failing
